newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iranian, Japanese win top Cannes film award.
newsitem.headline: Iranian, Japanese win top Cannes film award.

text.p: The 50th Cannes film festival awarded a joint Golden Palm best film prize to Japanese Director Shohei Imamura for "The Eel" and Iranian Director Abbas Kiarostami for "The Taste of the Cherry" on Sunday.
The jury President, French actress Isabelle Adjani, announced a special 50th anniversary prize awarded to Egypt's Youssef Chahine for all his work.
"The Sweet Hereafter", by Canada's Atom Egoyan, won a runner-up Grand Jury Prize at the televised award ceremony.
Sean Penn was voted best actor for "She's so Lovely" by fellow American Nick Cassavetes.
Kathy Burke was voted best actress for "Nil by Mouth" by Britain's Gary Oldman.
